module: WebSocket HTTP/1.1 handshake (upgrade) for lua-websockets: building the client request, parsing headers, server-side validation and computing Sec-WebSocket-Accept (SHA-1 of the key + RFC 6455 GUID, base64-encoded). Used by websocket/sync and the server backends.
notes: http_headers lowercases the header names; the values too, except for headers containing 'sec-websocket' (key and accept keep their case).
Assertions fail (assert(false, line)) if a header line is malformed.

sec_websocket_accept.desc: Computes the Sec-WebSocket-Accept value: SHA-1 of (key .. GUID 258EAFA5-E914-47DA-95CA-C5AB0DC85B11) then base64.

sec_websocket_key.desc: Value of the Sec-WebSocket-Key header sent by the client.

http_headers.desc: Parses a plain-text HTTP/1.1 request/response. If the first line does not end with HTTP/1.1, returns an empty table.

returns.desc: Lowercase headers; duplicates are joined by a comma.
Body after the blank line, if any.

accept_upgrade.desc: Server side: checks that a request is a valid WebSocket upgrade (Upgrade: websocket, Connection containing upgrade, key present, version 13) and builds the '101 Switching Protocols' response. Picks the first requested subprotocol that is in the supported list.

returns.desc: HTTP 101 response, or nil if the request is invalid.
Selected subprotocol; on refusal, 'HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request' as the second value.

upgrade_request.desc: Client side: builds the text of the WebSocket upgrade GET request (version 13) with Host, key, and optional subprotocols, extra headers and Origin.

req.desc: Fields: uri, host, port (appended to Host if it is something other than 80), key, protocols (list of strings), extra_headers (name->value table), origin.
